description: Wasserschutzgebiete und Wasserschongebiete Wien is a dataset listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by data.wien.gv.at. Water protection and sanitation areas of Vienna; pursuant to Paragraph 34(1) and (2) of the WRG 1959 and pursuant to the Ordinance of the LH of Vienna on the ‘Heilquelle Oberlaa’ water conservation area. Coverage: AT. The portal shows the English title as "Water Protection Areas and Water Conservation Areas Vienna" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include ViennaGIS, Wasserschongebiet, Wasserschutzgebiet, Wasserschutz, Schongebiete, Schutzgebiete. The listing shows 6 download or service links in JPEG, KMZ, GIF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
